doRedundancyAnalysis.note: No argument for the global/criterion item: from the help, the redundancy analysis needs the formative construct to be linked to a reflectively measured construct in the model specification by the user.

result.conclusion_from_source: cSEM's doRedundancyAnalysis() is NOT the textbook (Chin 1998) redundancy analysis against a global single item: for every Mode B block it re-estimates the model with that block in Mode A and returns the OLS slope of the Mode A score on the Mode B score.

second_order.syntax_note: a construct whose 'indicators' are other constructs is a second-order construct; '<~' gives a composite of the first-order construct scores

interaction.model_line: ATU ~ PEOU + PU + PEOU.PU   (cSEM: product of construct scores, written with '.')

check.note: OLS of ATU score on PEOU, PU and their (unstandardised) product; cSEM standardises the product term, so only the main-effect slopes and the t-value of the product are comparable
